binarization.positive_rate_definition: pair-level any-endpoint conflict rate (EITHER endpoint degraded >= threshold_rel vs its native adapter) — NOT a per-task-side rate; see per-endpoint marginals

dependence_note: DYADIC DEPENDENCE (round-1 review fix): pairs sharing an endpoint run are NOT independent observations. The headline numbers use StratifiedGroupKFold over run-overlap connected components (no run in both train and test pairs) and a component-cluster bootstrap. The 'naive' block (StratifiedKFold over pairs, pair-iid bootstrap) is anti-conservative and reported for comparison only — it must never be quoted as the result.

naive.cv: StratifiedKFold over pairs — run overlap across folds possible; anti-conservative
